content:
frank: Rolling packaging window for private/vpc at 02:10 UTC. Aim: ship signed installer + delta patch to escorts. Need final checksum and cosign handoff.

rachel: I'm running delta-apply and will produce a diff bundle. ETA 9m. Noted two stray debug files to strip.

simon: Reminder: our transport bridge can reorder small chunk manifests when latency spikes. Recommend enable chunk-seq header and a small per-node jitter (0-1500ms).

ops-kim: Ops constraint: abort if >3 verify failures in any lane within 7m or if average pull latency >90s for 5m. I'll set alerts.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] staging pin private-installer@v2024.08.21 -> sha256:dd44...77aa. uploaded to s3://redwood-offline/releases/1768000001/ awaiting cosign.

rachel: Delta bundle ready. Running gzip + checksum. Found one file with different mtime; standardizing and re-tarring. +4m.

frank: If repack >10m we move window +45m. No surprise cutovers.

simon: Pushing chunk-seq header change now. Also enabling jitter=rand(0,1500ms) in escort runner. Non-blocking for canary.

ops-kim: Added alert rules. Also will auto-invalidate cosign cache on first seed pull to avoid stale pubkey failures.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] cosign signed by key installer-signer-04. cosign.pub uploaded to s3://redwood-offline/keys/cosign-2024-08.pub.

rachel: Verified signature and checksum locally. Pin ready.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary scheduled: lanes=[west,east,central], seeds=6, spacing=75s, observe=20m, pin sha256:dd44...77aa.

simon: Canary report (12m): west OK, east partial (1 node failed verify), central OK. Failure due to old cosign.pub cached on that mirror.

ops-kim: Invalidating cache and forcing re-verify on that node. If it fails twice, we evict and re-seed.

rachel: Node recovered after invalidation. All seeds verified. Throughput stable.

frank: Proceed to rolling batches in 8m. Rolling plan: batches of 5 nodes, 10m pause between batches.

ops-kim: Rollback commands saved in runbook:
```
deploy-bot rollback --target private-installer --pin v2024.07.30
opsctl escort evict --label=canary
```

deploy-bot: [deploybot] rolling started: batch_size=5 pause=10m. KMS audit id KMS-2024-08-21-01 logged.

simon: Post-roll: add manifest chunk-seq unit test to packaging CI and ensure mirror-agent honors cosign pubkey update hook. Filing ticket.

frank: Rolling complete. No evictions. Artifact TTL set 120d. Shipping release notes to private-customers. Closing thread.
